overall_intent: A grounded photographic investigative interview where specific inquiry material, reciprocal attention and a witness's spatial explanation make a new lead readable. Reference appearance is narrow; all case circumstances and test details are authorial.

contact_point.reason: The information exchange is carried by an observable fingertip-to-route contact and a separately held identification portrait.
contact_point.expressive_goal: Make a witness supplying specific spatial information physically legible while the investigator visibly receives it.
observable_targets: witness fingertip meeting one diagram branch
investigator holding a distinct portrait by its corner
owner_relations: attendant owns pointing forearm and fingertip
investigator owns portrait-holding left hand and pen-holding right hand
diagram and notebook are distinct objects on one counter
required_constraints: reference face and hair cues stay on the investigator
preserved_choices: contact endpoint readable together with both participants
open_scope: local object spacing, contact orientation and counter projection that improve a believable interview
contact_point.role_focus: A ferry attendant gives a case investigator specific route information by touching one branch of a simple landing diagram; her paused pen and held identification portrait connect the answer to the inquiry.
contact_point.scene_context: Across a ferry ticket-booth counter after the last crossing, the investigator listens as a locally knowledgeable witness explains a crossing.

grounds.quote: An investigator seeks case information while an attendant indicates a route and she pauses her note to follow it.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role concerns actual contact endpoints and ownership in a presently visible information exchange. The route diagram and hand arrangement are replaceable authorial staging, not requester facts.

situation_context.reason: The place and working circumstances should explain why this attendant can answer the investigator's question.
situation_context.expressive_goal: An inhabited canvassing encounter in which a photograph prompts a concrete witness answer and a fresh note.
observable_targets: investigator follows the new route information
booth window connects to the empty landing
owner_relations: investigator directs a question toward attendant
attendant supplies site-specific information to investigator
outside gangway belongs to the ferry workplace
required_constraints: retain the meaning of investigative fiction as active case inquiry
use reference only for investigator visible face/hair
preserved_choices: grounded reciprocal interview rather than generic posed portrait
case target distinct from investigator and witness
open_scope: restrained local circumstances, evidence arrangement or response timing that clarify the encounter
situation_context.role_focus: A present investigative canvass at a ferry ticket booth: an investigator shows a person's portrait and pauses her case notes as the ferry attendant identifies a route on a simple landing diagram.
situation_context.scene_context: The last ferry has gone; the empty gangway outside places the witness in a position to have observed crossings. The scene centers on receiving useful information.

grounds.quote: An investigator seeks case information while an attendant indicates a route and she pauses her note to follow it.
Closed riverside ferry ticket booth at dusk; invented and replaceable.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The situation should remain visually supported by question material, witness response and local setting. It may imply a lead, but cannot prove a crime, truthfulness or identification accuracy from one still image.
